title: One-way hour, signed
source: net60 = C[t]-C[t-60]; path = sum_{i=0..11}|C[t-5i]-C[t-5i-5]|; eff = net60/path. |net60| bottom third vs this minute = 'no hour move'; else direction = sign(net60), one-way if |eff| ranks top half vs this minute, else two-way. Field: close of state/spx_jev/bars (or store spx_bars).
rank_against: this time of day on prior sessions

examples.answer: net -0.038 sigma, efficiency -0.13 (rank both vs this minute)
net -0.296 sigma, efficiency -0.60 (rank both vs this minute)
net -0.124 sigma, efficiency -0.35 (rank both vs this minute)

notes: price.hour_one_way is close but measures crossings of the hourly average, not net/summed-5-min efficiency; use bars. History: store spx_bars has 66 sessions (07-06 on), live bars files only 12 days.

title: Move speeding up or fading
source: d20 = C[t-10]-C[t-30]; d10 = C[t]-C[t-10]; ratio = sign(d20)*d10 / (|d20|/2). 'reversing' if ratio < 0 by more than a fixed tolerance (in opening-straddle units: |d10|/em_open > tol); else rank ratio vs this minute: top third accelerating, middle steady, bottom fading. em_open from the diary row (state/reversion range_ruler.em_open).
rank_against: this time of day on prior sessions

examples.answer: d10 -2.03 pts, prior d20 +2.51 pts, pace ratio -1.62 (opposite)
d10 -1.95 pts, prior d20 -12.99 pts, pace ratio +0.30 (rank vs this minute)
d10 +0.81 pts, prior d20 -14.39 pts, pace ratio -0.11 (opposite)

notes: momentum.pace is unsigned and compares 10 vs the previous 10 minutes (not 20) with fixed 2/3 and 1.5 cuts, so it cannot give 'reversing'.

title: Pullback in the leg, signed
source: 60-min window [t-60,t]: net = C[t]-C[t-60]; leg only if |net| > this minute's median |net| on prior sessions. Up leg: ext = max high in window at minute i; push = ext-C[t-60]; giveback = (ext-C[t])/push; deep = giveback > this minute's median giveback; fast = (ext-C[t])/(60-i) > push/i. Mirror for down legs.
rank_against: this time of day on prior sessions

examples.answer: 60m net -0.038 sigma, given back 63%, pullback faster than push
60m net -0.296 sigma, given back 13%, pullback faster than push
60m net -0.124 sigma, given back 33%, pullback faster than push

notes: two medians (leg size, giveback) per minute-of-day from prior sessions; spx_bars store covers it.

title: 60-minute range sweep: held or failed
source: H/L = max high / min low over bars [t-70,t-10); break up if max high of bars [t-10,t) > H + 0.02*sigma (fixed tolerance); held if C[t] > H else failed; mirror for down. sigma = read's sigma.
rank_against: fixed rule (no ranking)
notes: no history needed; tolerance value (0.02 sigma here) is a design choice to fix.

title: Biggest 1-minute bar vs normal

notes: price.minute_width only compares the current minute to today's typical minute with a fixed 2x cut; shock.burst is 5-minute moves. Use bars. Bars volume field is 0 for SPX (index), so no volume weighting.
